newsitem.title: USA: Restart of Tosco Calif. coker seen delayed.
newsitem.headline: Restart of Tosco Calif. coker seen delayed.

text.p: Tosco Corp will restart a 42,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) coker at its Avon, Calif., refinery "a couple days" later than originally planned, said a trade source familiar with the plant.
"Now its looks like it will be delayed," the source said. "It'll be back roughly on (February) 28," he said.
Other traders thought the unit would restart February 20, but the trade source claimed that initial restart had been set for February 22.
He said the delay was caused by an explosion and fire at the plant's hydrocracking unit in late January.
The hydrocracking unit is expected to remain down until June, according to trade sources.
